identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][297.c][test] Prove projection recovery crash, topology, race, and idempotency behavior

values.task_boundary: Issue #300 deterministic integrated proof only; no production redesign or parent/upstream lifecycle mutation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every approved recovery and cleanup durability/mutation boundary has deterministic interruption-before and interruption-after proof against production code.
AC-2: Every restart reaches the same exact result or fails closed while preserving evidence without sleeps or scheduler luck.
AC-3: Identity, topology, ownership, permission, mount, hardlink, type, corruption, CAS, collision, substitution, and ambiguity negatives are exercised.
AC-4: Repeated classify/recover/cleanup and a subsequent ordinary typed commit prove idempotency and intended gate release.
AC-5: No unrelated file or replacement inode is deleted and immutable ledgers remain.
AC-6: Existing initialized/ready recovery and #291 behavior remain green.
AC-7: VPP/SOR name only tests actually run and results observed.
AC-8: Exact-head #119 review has no unresolved actionable finding.

Validated typed terminal #299 and head/merge ancestral to #300 execution base
